2174-2645-3230-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1432-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1432-5107-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

4613-4687-7203.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Brigid has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4687-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other creatures

5276-6412-6495.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.
5276-6412-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1506-3713-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Burning Anger by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target
Repeat steps 4 and 5 once, then repeat step 4 an additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

250-779-1479-4693-7885.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-7885.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-4693-7885.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

3378-3821-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
3378-3821-4823.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3378-3821-4823.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

186-4131-7290.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-4131-7290.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Does Machines.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

628-6798-7197.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4068-4091-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-4477--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-4477--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

1902-1978-2750.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1902-1978-2750.description:
Cause Wirewood Channeler to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat from step 2.

997-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-6872--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4050-5544-5708.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Vein Ripper triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and gaining 2 life.
Repeat.

186-913-4222-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
186-913-4222-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

372-3277-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-3277-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

945-1385-2452-2530-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
945-1385-2452-2530-5256.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {0}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Relentless Dead.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Zulaport Cutthroat.
Resolve the first Relentless Dead trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Relentless Dead trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Relentless Dead's power.
Repeat.

1349-1999-2793-4050-4241.manaNeeded: {1} the first turn, with {6} available each extra turn
1349-1999-2793-4050-4241.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1349-1999-2793-4050-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability triggers, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {U}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing to not put an artifact onto the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2972-3750-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Ganax.
Ganax does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent cannot block and kill Ganax.
2972-3750-3851.description:
Declare Ganax as an attacker.
Ganax's myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Ganax a number of times equal to the number of tokens created.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1826-2073-4050.description:
Activate Origin Spellbomb by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Origin Spellbomb leaves the battlefield; choose not to pay for its trigger to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {1}.
The Myr dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Origin Spellbomb from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

575-656-5033.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Ugin's Conjurant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3356-3896.description:
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Polyraptor enters the battlefield, triggering Where Ancients Tread, dealing 5 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2.

231-2478-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
231-2478-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, returning Mishra's Bauble from graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, putting Time Warp from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mishra's Bauble triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
